'''January 2002 Melbourne tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 6 January 2002. It is known from Ronnie Wilcox's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3235">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-06-melbourne-whats-todays-dated3235/ melbourne-whats-todays-date], DeckTech (Ronnie "AD-fig" Wilcox, 6 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-06-melbourne-whats-todays-dated3235/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 January 2002
* '''Site:''' Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Adam Amy]]<ref name="tr-d3249" />
